notes.title: WARDEN ON THE JOB IS NOW OUT!
notes.content:
The anniversary update for Rectangle Guy is here (and maybe a bit late whoopsies). It includes a brand new epilogue to the game's main story called "Warden on the Job".

Warden on the Job includes 5 challenging levels and a new boss, and is meant for players who have already beaten the main story of Rectangle Guy.

If you've already beaten the game, you can jump right into the new update, just check out the "Unlockables" menu. If you haven't beaten the game yet, well, you got some work to do.

notes.title: Rectangle Guy: Warden on the Job releasing Friday!
notes.content:
WOAAAHH!!! THERE'S NEW RECTANGLE GUY CONTENT?!?! Yep, that's right, there's new Rectangle Guy content in the form of this FREE DLC. Warden on the Job is a brand new mini-campaign with new levels, a new boss, and a bunch of new mechanics to mess around with. 

You once again take the role of Rectangle Guy, embarking on another journey. Last time, Rectangle Guy reclaimed his throne as Warden of the True Void, and now, he has to actually do his damn job. The True Void has been causing mass amounts of corruption, and only Rectangle Guy has the power to close the rifts and reverse the damage done.
